GEOGRAPHY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Underground Water is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Underground Water with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Underground Water as rumours only.
   C. Say Underground Water never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Underground Water.

2. Which statement about Lakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Lakes.
   B. Say Lakes never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Lakes as rumours only.
   D. Explain Lakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   D. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.

5. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

6. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.

7. Which statement about Glaciation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Glaciation as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Glaciation.
   C. Explain Glaciation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Glaciation never happens in Kenya.

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only

9. Which statement about Action of wind and water in arid areas is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Action of wind and water in arid areas never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Action of wind and water in arid areas with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Action of wind and water in arid areas.
   D. Treat Action of wind and water in arid areas as rumours only.

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

11. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   C. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   D. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Karst Scenery is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Karst Scenery never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Karst Scenery.
   C. Explain Karst Scenery with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Karst Scenery as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Oceans, Seas and Coasts is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Oceans, Seas and Coasts.
   B. Explain Oceans, Seas and Coasts with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Oceans, Seas and Coasts never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Oceans, Seas and Coasts as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Trade as rumours only.
   B. Explain Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Trade never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Trade.

15. Which statement about Fishing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Fishing as rumours only.
   B. Explain Fishing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing.
   D. Say Fishing never happens in Kenya.

16. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Glaciation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Settlement and urbanisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Action of wind and water in arid areas and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Lakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
